title: An integral tensor model with every exact Fibonacci parameter

source.title: Hexagonal extensions of toroidal maps and hypermaps
source.reading_scope: Exact presentation/local adapters and problem statement; this package adds no new whole-paper reading claim.

theorems.result: Literal integral 8-by-8 tensor representation with a simultaneous inversion involution; exact finite identities.
For every integer s>=3, reduction modulo Fibonacci F_s has torus word T of exact order s.
For every integer s>=4, omitted-type parabolics have exact orders 36,12s^2,48,108 and are marked-isomorphic to the source toroidal groups by presentation and order.

method: Full matrix-factor algebras over composite rings
Two independent torus translations and finite factor permutations
retained_inputs: Source local toroidal presentations and their order formula 12(a^2+ab+b^2)
Literal finite integer closures of the three protected subgroups, independently reproducible with the supplied checker

reviews.root: Full written proof and code review reported PASS before freeze; separate hash-bound record owned by root.
reviews.rank_stability: Full written proof/code review and fresh byte-identical checker report reported PASS before freeze; separate hash-bound record owned by reviewer.

limitations: No ambient subgroup intersection-property or typed coset-Helly assertion.
No all-parameter hypertope conclusion or complete Problem 9.2 resolution.
At s=3, modulus two collapses the required order-48 local group to order 12.
No faithful identification of P_omit or equality with universal parameter groups.
formal_boundary: A separate parent-owned FibonacciModulus Lean module may certify the scalar-exponent arithmetic; no Lean module is required by this manifest and no full tensor or geometry formalization is claimed.
